newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Death toll 53 Arabs, 13 Israelis at 1450 gmt.
newsitem.headline: Death toll 53 Arabs, 13 Israelis at 1450 gmt.

text.p: Sixty-six people -- 53 Palestinians and 13 Israeli soldiers -- have died in three days of clashes, Palestinian medical officials and Israeli security sources said on Friday.

Seven Palestinians died in clashes on Friday -- three of them shot dead by Israeli forces on Jerusalem Temple Mount. Two Israeli border policeman died in a gunbattle with Palestinians in the West Bank.

Two Palestinians shot by Israeli forces in Gaza died of their wounds on Friday, raising the total from Thursday's fighting to 41 Palestinians and 11 Israelis. Five Palestinians were shot dead on Wednesday, the first day of fighting.
